section_summary.extract_value: The provided text is a reference entry for Andrew, Tiggemann, & Clark (2014). The attached figure (Fig. 1) shows three panels (A–C) of an indirect effect model relating various body size discrepancy predictors to Body Appreciation via Body Image Flexibility, each panel reporting the same sample size (N=84). The caption indicates standardized beta coefficients for the unadjusted models in all panels.
